intro: Salary, rent, subscriptions and installment plans. Every month Nublar creates the transaction and confirms it on its own on the date (on a card, when the statement closes). Until then you can adjust or skip it.

search.label: Search recurring items
search.placeholder: Search by description, category or account

empty.title: No recurring items
empty.description: Add what repeats (salary, rent, Netflix on the card, a purchase in 10 installments) so you don't have to enter it by hand every month.

notFound.title: No recurring items found
notFound.description: Check your search and try again.

errors.end: The end must be after the start.

form.cardHint: It goes on every statement, on its due date. No need to pick a day.
form.editHint: Changes update the pending items. What's already confirmed stays the same.
